expectations.text: States that instructions to a model are not enforcement, regardless of wording or emphasis
expectations.evidence: instructions hold ~90% of the time regardless of caps or repetition — long contexts, compaction, and subagents that never read the file all erode them

expectations.text: Redirects away from rewording CLAUDE.md as the primary fix
expectations.evidence: To get to zero you need a device that runs before the tool call, not prose the model is supposed to remember... Then delete the CLAUDE.md lines

expectations.text: Recommends permission deny rules in settings.json with concrete syntax
expectations.evidence: Shows deny rules for Edit(./src/generated/**), Write(./src/generated/**), Bash(git push --force:*), etc.

expectations.text: Recommends a PreToolUse hook for cases that need logic rather than a pattern match
expectations.evidence: needs a `PreToolUse` hook on `Bash` that scans the command for `src/generated/`

expectations.text: Explains that the deny message should say what to do instead, not merely refuse
expectations.evidence: A bare refusal produces a workaround... Write it like an error message for a colleague: Blocked: edit to `src/generated/`... edit the schema and re-run codegen instead

expectations.text: Recommends verifying the device actually fires rather than assuming it works
expectations.evidence: Prove it fires. Ask Claude to force push and to edit a generated file; confirm the denial and that the message shows

expectations.text: Recommends committing the rules so they apply to the whole team, not just one machine
